lines.text: Customers often return clothes because of size problems.
- Customers shall request a return within 30 days of delivery.
- The system shall create a pickup request after a return is approved.
- Refunds are sent to the original payment method.
- Customers shall request a return within 15 days of delivery.
- The refund shall reach the customer within 7 working days.
- The returns page should be simple and clear.
- Admins shall approve or reject each return request.
- Admins should see a weekly report of return reasons.
- The module must work with the existing payment gateway API.
- The system will log every change to a return request.
Note: the team will review these rules after the festive sale.
